66089-balancing-and-shoeing-trotting-and.title: TROTTING and PACING HORSES
66089-balancing-and-shoeing-trotting-and.creator: Wm. J. Moore
66089-balancing-and-shoeing-trotting-and.description: A book by Wm. J. Moore. Moore tell his readers in his own words and in his own way how to shoe a trotter or a pacer, so that it may do its best work in the easiest way, and for the greatest benefit to its owner.

arxiv-2105-01464.title: Universal role of commuting in the reduction of social assortativity in cities
arxiv-2105-01464.creator: Eszter Bokányi, Sándor Juhász, Márton Karsai, Balázs Lengyel
arxiv-2105-01464.description: Abstract Millions commute to work every day in cities and interact with colleagues, customers, providers, friends, and strangers. Commuting facilitates the mixing of people from distant and diverse neighborhoods, but whether this has an imprint on social inclusion or instead, connections remain assortative is less explored.

arxiv-2112-13874.title: Unbiased Parameter Inference for a Class of Partially Observed Lévy-Process Models
arxiv-2112-13874.description: Abstract We consider the problem of static Bayesian inference for partially observed Lévy-process models. We develop a methodology which allows one to infer static parameters and some states of the process, without a bias from the time-discretization of the afore-mentioned Lévy process. The unbiased method is exceptionally amenable to parallel implementation and can be computationally efficient relative to competing approaches.

arxiv-2202-03578.title: Data-driven design of optical resonators
arxiv-2202-03578.creator: Joeri Lenaerts
arxiv-2202-03578.description: Abstract Abstract The field of Nanophotonics has evolved rapidly over the last years. Optical devices lie at the heart of most of the technology we see around us. When one actually wants to make such an optical device, one encounters the problem that it is very difficult to predict its optical behavior.

arxiv-2207-04660.title: SummScore: A Comprehensive Evaluation Metric for Summary Quality Based on Cross-Encoder
arxiv-2207-04660.creator: Wuhang Lin *, Shasha Li *, Chen Zhang, Bin Ji, Jie Yu 🖂, Jun Ma, Zibo Yi
arxiv-2207-04660.description: Abstract Text summarization models are often trained to produce summaries that meet human quality requirements. However, the existing evaluation metrics for summary text are only rough proxies for summary quality, suffering from low correlation with human scoring and inhibition of summary diversity. To solve these problems, we propose SummScore, a comprehensive metric for summary quality evaluation based on Cross-Encoder.

arxiv-2208-05952.title: Partition Pooling for Convolutional Graph Network Applications in Particle Physics
arxiv-2208-05952.creator: and C. Wiebusch
arxiv-2208-05952.description: Abstract Convolutional graph networks are used in particle physics for effective event reconstructions and classifications. However, their performances can be limited by the considerable amount of sensors used in modern particle detectors if applied to sensor-level data. We present a pooling scheme that uses partitioning to create pooling kernels on graphs, similar to pooling on images.

arxiv-2210-09645.title: Cones from maximum h h -scattered linear sets and a stability result for cylinders from hyperovals
arxiv-2210-09645.creator: Sam Adriaensen, Jonathan Mannaert, Paolo Santonastaso, Ferdinando Zullo
arxiv-2210-09645.description: Abstract . This paper mainly focuses on cones whose basis is a maximum h h -scattered linear set. We start by investigating the intersection sizes of such cones with the hyperplanes. Then we analyze two constructions of point sets with few intersection sizes with the hyperplanes.

arxiv-2303-07615.title: Variation of Gender Biases in Visual Recognition Models Before and After Finetuning
arxiv-2303-07615.creator: Jaspreet Ranjit University of Southern California jranjit@usc.edu Baishakhi Ray Columbia University rayb@cs.columbia.edu and Tianlu Wang Meta AI tianluwang@meta.com Vicente Ordonez Rice University vicenteor@rice.edu
arxiv-2303-07615.description: Abstract We introduce a framework to measure how biases change before and after fine-tuning a large scale visual recognition model for a downstream task. Deep learning models trained on increasing amounts of data are known to encode societal biases. Many computer vision systems today rely on models typically pretrained on large scale datasets.

arxiv-2305-01448.title: Very well–covered graphs via the Rees algebra
arxiv-2305-01448.creator: Marilena Crupi, Antonino Ficarra
arxiv-2305-01448.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by Marilena Crupi, Antonino Ficarra. A very well–covered graph is a well–covered graph without isolated vertices such that the size of its minimal vertex covers is half of the number of vertices. If G G is a Cohen–Macaulay very well–covered graph, we deeply investigate some algebraic properties of the cover ideal of G G via the Rees algebra associated to the ideal, and especially when G G is a whisker graph. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2305-12071.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Junzhe Cao a, Sha Liu a b, Sirui Yang a, Chengwen Zhong a b. arxiv-2309-14543.title: T-duality/plurality of BTZ black hole metric coupled to two fermionic fields
arxiv-2309-14543.creator: Ali Eghbali, Meysam Hosseinpour-Sadid, Adel Rezaei-Aghdam
arxiv-2309-14543.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ali Eghbali, Meysam Hosseinpour-Sadid, Adel Rezaei-Aghdam. We ask the question of classical super (non-)Abelian T-duality for BTZ black hole metric coupling to two fermionic fields. Our approach is based on super Poisson-Lie (PL) T-duality in the presence of spectator fields.

arxiv-2310-09684.title: Generalization of one-center non orthogonal configuration interaction singles to open shell singlet reference states: Theory and application to valence-core pump-probe states in acetylacetone
arxiv-2310-09684.creator: Juan E. Arias-Martinez, Hamlin Wu, Martin Head-Gordon
arxiv-2310-09684.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Juan E. Arias-Martinez, Hamlin Wu, Martin Head-Gordon. We formulate a one-center non-orthogonal configuration interaction singles (1C-NOCIS) theory for the computation of core excited states of an initial singlet state with two unpaired electrons. This model, which we refer to as 1C-NOCIS two-electron open-shell (2eOS), is appropriate for computing the K-edge near-edge X-ray absorption spectra (NEXAS) of the valence excited states of closed-shell molecules relevant to pump-probe time-resolved (TR) NEXAS experiments.

arxiv-2407-03142.creator: Urmila Chadayammuri, Ákos Bogdán, Gerrit Schellenberger, John ZuHone
arxiv-2407-03142.description: Abstract Abell 2744, also known as Pandora’s Cluster, is a complex merging galaxy cluster. While a major merger is clear along the north-south axis, the dynamical state of the northwest subcluster has been highly uncertain. We present ultra-deep ( ≈ \approx 2.

arxiv-2509-05521.title: Weak solutions of port-Hamiltonian systems Thanks: The author gratefully acknowledges funding from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation), Project-ID 531152215, CRC 1701 “Port-Hamiltonian Systems”.
arxiv-2509-05521.creator: Timo Reis
arxiv-2509-05521.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Timo Reis. We consider port-Hamiltonian systems from a geometric perspective, where the quantities involved such as state, flows, and efforts evolve in (possibly infinite-dimensional) Banach spaces. The main contribution of this article is the introduction of a weak solution concept. In this framework we show that the derivative of the state naturally lives in a space that, for ordinary evolution equations, plays the role of an extrapolation space.

arxiv-2511-14605.title: Characterization of a CsI(Tl) Scintillator Coupled to a SiPM at Cryogenic Temperatures
arxiv-2511-14605.creator: M. Mirzakhani, R. Mahapatra, M. Platt
arxiv-2511-14605.description: Abstract We report on the scintillation characterization of a 1 ​ cm 3 1\,\text{cm}^{3} CsI(Tl) crystal coupled to a 6 × 6 ​ mm 2 6\times 6\,\text{mm}^{2} SiPM read out with a custom transimpedance amplifier at cryogenic temperatures. The crystal was prepared with optical-grade surfaces and enclosed in a multi-layer shielding system to suppress both ambient light and background radiation.

pmc-10500738.title: Cancer incidence in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, 2020
pmc-10500738.creator: Farhana Badar, Muhammad Sohaib, Shahid Mahmood, Omar Rasheed Chughtai, Faisal Sultan, Muhammed Aasim Yusuf
pmc-10500738.description: BackgroundTo present the population-based cancer statistics for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP), Pakistan, an incidence study was conducted at the Shaukat Khanum Memorial Cancer Hospital and Research Centre (SKMCH&RC) in Lahore, Pakistan, in 2023.MethodsRecords from various centres on new cancers diagnosed among residents of KP between January and December 2020 were gathered.

pmc-10541878.title: Enhanced YOLOv5 network-based object detection (BALFilter Reader) promotes PERFECT filter-enabled liquid biopsy of lung cancer from bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF)
pmc-10541878.creator: Zheng Liu, Jixin Zhang, Ningyu Wang, Yun’ai Feng, Fei Tang, Tingyu Li, Liping Lv, Haichao Li, Wei Wang, Yaoping Liu
pmc-10541878.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Liquid biopsy of cancers, detecting tumor-related information from liquid samples, has attracted wide attentions as an emerging technology. Our previously reported large-area PERFECT (Precise-Efficient-Robust-Flexible-Easy-Controllable-Thin) filter has demonstrated competitive sensitivity in recovering rare tumor cells from clinical samples. However, it is time-consuming and easily biased to manually inspect rare target cells among numerous background cells distributed in a large area (Φ ≥ 13 mm). This puts forward an urgent demand for rapid and bias-free inspection.

pmc-10602939.title: Methodology and Results of a Joint IFSO-WGO Delphi Survey of 94 Intercontinental, Interdisciplinary Experts in Obesity Management
pmc-10602939.creator: Lilian Kow, Reem Z. Sharaiha, Mary O’Kane, Kevin P. White, Guilherme Macedo, Jim Toouli, Scott Shikora
pmc-10602939.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundObesity affects 1.5 billion people worldwide, yet few are treated effectively and considerable variability exists in its management. In 2020, a joint International Federation of Surgery for Obesity and Metabolic Diseases (IFSO) and World Gastroenterology Organization (WGO) advisory committee initiated the drafting of consensus guidelines on obesity management, to be based on detailed literature reviews and the results of an extensive multi-disciplinary survey of intercontinental experts. This paper reports on the latter.

pmc-11547468.title: Optimization and Multimachine Learning Algorithms to Predict Nanometal Surface Area Transfer Parameters for Gold and Silver Nanoparticles
pmc-11547468.creator: Steven M. E. Demers, Christopher Sobecki, Larry Deschaine
pmc-11547468.description: Interactions between gold metallic nanoparticles and molecular dyes have been well described by the nanometal surface energy transfer (NSET) mechanism. However, the expansion and testing of this model for nanoparticles of different metal composition is needed to develop a greater variety of nanosensors for medical and commercial applications.

pmc-11863807.title: Liquid biopsy for lung cancer: A cross section on the diagnostic routine experience of a referral Italian institution
pmc-11863807.creator: Caterina de Luca, Gianluca Russo, Mariantonia Nacchio, Maria Ingenito, Lucia Palumbo, Gianluca Gragnano, Floriana Conticelli, Maria Russo, Danilo Rocco, Cesare Gridelli, Roberto Bianco, Domenico Galetta, Giancarlo Troncone, Paola Parente, Antonino Iaccarino
pmc-11863807.description: BackgroundLung cancer is the leading cause of cancer death worldwide. Over the last decade, molecular testing of a growing number of predictive biomarkers has become mandatory in the management of NSCLC patients. However, a major obstacle in routine clinical practice is the scant quantity of available tissue specimens obtainable from advanced stage of NSCLC patients.

pmc-12401945.title: 3D Habitat Complexity and Coral Morphology Modulate Reef Fish Functional Structure in a Marine National Park
pmc-12401945.creator: Sofia B Ferreira, John H R Burns, Atsuko Fukunaga, Lillian J Tuttle Raz, Sheila A McKenna, Kailea Annandale, Ryan J Monello
pmc-12401945.description: The ongoing degradation of coral reef habitats is widely acknowledged to have adverse effects on the abundance and diversity of reef fish populations, yet the direct effects on ecosystem functions remain uncertain. This study used a quantitative approach to determine the mechanistic links between fish assemblages and ecological function.

pmc-12563803.title: Relationships Among Bullying Experiences, Mood Symptoms and Suicidality in Subjects with and Without Autism Spectrum Conditions
pmc-12563803.creator: Liliana Dell’Osso, Benedetta Nardi, Stefano Pini, Gabriele Massimetti, Lucrezia Castellani, Francesca Parri, Filippo Del Grande, Chiara Bonelli, Carmen Concerto, Matteo Di Vincenzo, Bianca Della Rocca, Maria Salvina Signorelli, Laura Fusar-Poli, Camilla Figini, Pierluigi Politi, Eugenio Aguglia, Mar
pmc-12563803.description: Background: Bullying is a major public health issue with long-term psychological consequences, particularly for individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) or subthreshold autistic traits, known as “broad autistic phenotype” (BAP). Prior studies have suggested increased vulnerability to victimization and mood disorders in these populations, but the association between bullying, autistic traits, and affective symptoms remains underexplored.

pmc-13086017.title: Cycloastragenol Inhibits Colorectal Cancer Cell Metastasis via Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition and the PI3K Signalling Pathway
pmc-13086017.creator: JingRong Miao, PanFeng Feng
pmc-13086017.description: Metastasis remains a critical factor contributing to the low survival rates in colorectal cancer. The pathways through which cycloastragenol suppresses colorectal cancer metastasis are poorly defined. This research directly investigates its anti‐metastatic mechanisms. The anti‐proliferative effects of cycloastragenol were assessed using CCK‐8 assays, while its impact on migration, invasion and apoptosis was evaluated via Transwell assays and flow cytometry.

pmc-13297332.title: Postsynaptic Congenital Myasthenic Syndrome Mimicking Limb–Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Associated with an Alternatively Spliced Exon in CHRNB1: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-13297332.creator: Wen-Kan Feng, Kun-Long Hung, Ting-Hao Wang
pmc-13297332.description: Highlights What are the main findings? An adolescent male presented with a limb–girdle muscular dystrophy–like phenotype was finally diagnosed as postnatal congenital myasthenic syndrome after genetic identification of a hetrogyzous CHRNB1 mutation by WES.Clinical improvement was observed after adjusting the therapeutic regimen. What is the implication of the main finding?
